name: AI for Chemistry Club
description: A student-led academic community exploring artificial intelligence, chemistry and related fields of AI for Science.
about: AI for Chemistry Club brings together students interested in the intersection of artificial intelligence and chemical science. We aim to promote learning, discussion and practical exploration of AI approaches in chemistry, while encouraging connections across mathematics, physics and AI itself. Through interdisciplinary exchange and peer mentoring, we aim to help students learn from one another and use AI tools responsibly in scientific research and learning.
learningNote: Learning the foundations matters, too. Understanding AI methods and working with tools such as Git and GitHub can help us build the skills to explore scientific questions together.
activitiesIntro: We aim to bring students together through seminars, reading groups, workshops and student sharing sessions, creating opportunities to discuss ideas and explore AI in practice.

affiliation.text: A student-run Department-associated Group supported by the Department of Chemistry at The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology.

focusAreas.title: AI × Chemistry
focusAreas.description: Explore how AI methods can help us understand chemical systems and investigate scientific questions.

focusAreas.title: AI for Science
focusAreas.description: Connect ideas from mathematics, physics and other sciences, and learn across disciplines.

focusAreas.title: AI foundations & tools
focusAreas.description: Understand AI methods and develop practical skills in coding, using AI tools and collaborating with Git and GitHub.

activities.title: Getting started with AI & GitHub
activities.summary: We are preparing an introductory workshop on AI fundamentals and working with Git and GitHub. The date, format and programme will be announced once confirmed.
